text: I love playing Roblox with my best friend Sam. We always play this game called Adopt Me where you get cool pets. Yesterday, I got a legendary dragon! I yelled, "Look, Sam! It is flying!" But then my mom said I had to turn it off for dinner. After we ate, I watched Pokemon on TV. Ash was fighting a really strong Gym Leader. I wish I had a Pikachu in real life because he is super fast and cute. Playing games is the best part of the day.

I can't believe it's already summer vacation! Finally! Yesterday, my friend Sam came over and we built the biggest fort ever in the living room. We used every single blanket in the house. Even the itchy wool ones. "Don't touch the top!" I yelled when Sam almost knocked it down. It was so close. Phew! We're going to sleep in it tonight if my mom says yes. She usually says no to forts, but maybe this time will be different. Oh man, I hope she lets us keep it up forever. It's awesome inside!

My dad told me a cool story about a brave **knight** who lived on a tiny **island**. The knight had a shiny sword but he never used it to fight. Instead, he used it to cut giant watermelons! One day, he **thought** he saw a monster, but it was just his **daughter** playing dress-up. They laughed so hard. Then they ate the watermelon **straight** from the rind until they had **enough**. It was a funny story.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It had lots of butter on it. Then I went to school on the big yellow bus. We played kickball at recess and my team won the game. I kicked the ball very far! After school, I played with my dog in the yard. His name is Spot and he runs fast. For dinner, we had pizza with cheese. Now I am tired and ready for bed. It was a fun day.

Today was a very fun day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It had lots of butter on it. Then I went to the park with my dad. We played catch with a red ball. The sun was hot so we got ice cream. I picked chocolate and it was so good. After that, we came home and I played with my dog, Spot. He likes to run fast. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I love playing games on my tablet after school. My favorite game is Roblox because I can play lots of different obbys with my friends. Sometimes we play Hide and Seek Extreme and it is so funny. On the weekends, my big brother lets me play Minecraft on his computer. We built a huge castle with a secret door. If I finish all my homework, my mom lets me watch Pokemon on TV. Ash and Pikachu are the best team ever. I really want to catch them all someday!

I can’t believe it’s finally summer vacation! No more homework for weeks. It’s gonna be the best ever. Yesterday, my friend Leo came over and we built a huge fort in the living room. We used every blanket in the house. Oh man! My mom wasn't too happy about the mess, but she let us keep it up. We’re going to sleep inside it tonight with flashlights and comic books. I hope we don't get scared. No way! We’re brave. Summer is just awesome.

Today was a really fun day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It had lots of butter on it. Then, I went to the park with my dad. We played catch with my red ball. I love Saturdays because I can play video games all morning. First, I played Roblox with my best friend Sam. We played a game called Adopt Me and I got a super rare pet! It was so cool. Then my mom said, "Time for lunch!" After I ate my sandwich, I watched a Pokemon show on TV. Pikachu is my favorite because he is strong and yellow. Later, I built a giant castle in Minecraft. I put lava all around it so no zombies could get in. It was the best day ever.

Yesterday after school, I played Minecraft with my best friend Sam. We built a huge castle out of diamonds, but then a Creeper blew up the front door! I yelled, "Oh no, run away!" Sam laughed and said he would fix it. After that, we switched to Roblox and played a game where we had to be pizzas. It was so funny. Then my mom said it was time for dinner, but I really wanted to watch Pokemon on TV because Pikachu is my favorite. I hope I can play Fortnite tomorrow.

I thought being a knight would be super fun, but the armor is really heavy! My mom said I was strong enough to wear it for Halloween, but I could barely walk straight. I tried to run through the backyard, but I caught my shiny metal foot on a big rock. "Oh no!" I yelled. My little sister, who was dressed like a princess, laughed at me. "You look like a turtle on an island!" she said. Next year, I am just going to be a ghost.

One day, I pretended I was a brave **knight** fighting a dragon in my backyard. I ran **straight** at the dragon with my wooden sword. My little sister wanted to play too. She said she was the king’s **daughter** and she needed saving. I **thought** that was a good idea. We ran all around the grass until we were tired **enough** to stop. Then my mom yelled that dinner was ready, so we went inside. Being a hero makes you really hungry!

One time I had a super crazy dream. I was a brave **knight** riding a big horse. We went **straight** to a scary castle on a little **island**. A dragon lived there and he was really loud! I **thought** he looked hungry, so I threw him a sandwich. He ate it in one bite. Then he let me pass **through** the gate. It was the best dream ever, but then my mom woke me up for school. I was so mad!

My little sister wanted to play pretend. She was the princess and I was the brave knight. We made a big castle out of blankets in the living room. "Go straight through the tunnel!" she yelled at me. It was dark inside. I thought I saw a dragon, but it was just our cat, Fluffy. I caught him and held him tight. "You have enough brave points now," my sister said. Then we ate cookies on a pretend island made of pillows. Playing is fun but it makes me hungry.

I can't believe what happened at recess today! We were digging in the dirt near the swings when suddenly, Billy shouted, "No way!" He found the biggest worm ever. It was huge! Seriously, like a snake. We didn't want to touch it at first because it was super slimy, but then Sarah picked it up. Oh man! Everyone started screaming and running away. It's so funny when Sarah chases the boys. We're definitely going to look for more tomorrow. Best recess ever!

Yesterday was the best day ever because my mom let me play on her iPad for two whole hours. First, I played Roblox with my best friend Sam. We built a huge pizza restaurant in Bloxburg and made so much money. Then, I switched to Minecraft because I wanted to finish my castle. It is made of diamond blocks and has a secret trap door. After that, we watched a new Spider-Man show on TV. Spider-Man is so cool when he shoots webs. I wish I could play video games all day long!

One day, a brave **knight** went to a scary **island** to find a dragon. He walked **straight** into a dark cave. Suddenly, he heard a loud roar! The dragon jumped out and almost **caught** him. The knight ran **through** the trees as fast as he could. "That was close!" he yelled. He **thought** he was safe, but then he saw the dragon's **daughter**. She was actually very nice and gave him some cookies. It was weird but cool.

My favorite thing to do on Saturday is play Roblox with my best friend, Sam. We always play this game called Adopt Me where you get pets. Yesterday, I got a super rare dragon egg! It’s finally Saturday, and we’re going to the big park with the huge slide! I can’t wait. My brother says he’s going to climb the big tree, but Mom told him no way. It’s too dangerous. I grabbed my soccer ball and yelled, "Let's go!" But then I couldn't find my other shoe. Oh man! It was under the couch the whole time. Now we’re in the car, and Dad is singing really loud. It’s so embarrassing! I hope we get there soon because I really want ice cream later.

Oh man, you won’t believe what happened at recess today! We were playing tag near the big slide, and suddenly Tommy yelled, "Look out!" I turned around fast. Too fast. Bam! "It's okay," she said. Phew! We helped her clean it up with napkins. No way am I running near the teachers again. That was way too scary!

I can't believe what happened at recess today! We were playing tag near the big slide, and suddenly Tommy yelled, "Look out!" A huge squirrel jumped right over my head. Whoa! It landed on the swings and just sat there eating a nut. I’ve never seen a squirrel that brave before. We tried to get closer, but it ran up the pole. Fast! I hope it comes back tomorrow because I want to show my best friend Sarah. It’s going to be so cool if she sees it too.

I couldn’t believe my eyes when I walked into the kitchen. No way! My dog, Buster, was actually standing on top of the table. Right on top! He had his nose in the pizza box and was eating a whole slice of pepperoni. "Buster, get down!" I yelled, but he just wagged his tail. Oh man! Mom’s going to be so mad when she gets home. It’s a total mess in here. We’re definitely going to be in trouble, but Buster looked so happy with cheese on his nose that I couldn't help laughing. What a silly dog!

My big sister acted like a brave knight in our backyard. She held a stick straight up and yelled, "I am going to the secret island!" I ran after her but I got caught on a bush. "Wait for me!" I shouted. We pushed through the tall grass until we saw the slide. "That is the castle," she said. I thought it was just a slide, but playing with her was fun enough for me. We played until mom called us for dinner.

One day a brave knight went to a secret island to find some gold. He walked straight into the dark woods. Suddenly, he saw a giant dragon! The knight thought the dragon looked scary, but he wasn't afraid. He ran through the trees very fast. "I caught you!" yelled the knight. But the dragon just laughed. It was actually nice enough to give him a ride home. The knight told the King's daughter all about his big adventure.

After school, I ran to my room to play Roblox with my best friend Sam. We played a game called Adopt Me where you get cool pets. I got a neon dragon! I can't believe what happened at recess today! We were playing kickball, and Sarah kicked the ball so hard it went over the fence. Wow! It's totally gone. No way is anyone climbing over there to get it. I hope we don't get in trouble tomorrow.

I couldn’t believe my eyes when I walked into the kitchen. Wow! There was a giant chocolate cake sitting right on the counter. It was huge! My mom wasn't looking, so I tiptoed closer. Just a tiny taste? I reached out my finger, but then—bam! The dog barked super loud. "No way, Buster!" I whispered. But it was too late. Mom turned around and saw me. Oh man! She laughed and said, "We're saving that for later, buddy." I guess I have to wait, but it's going to be so good.

My big sister told me a funny story about a brave **knight**. She said he lived on a tiny **island** in the middle of a lake. One day, he tried to swim to shore, but he got **caught** in some seaweed! It was super sticky. He yelled for help, but nobody heard him. Finally, he pulled hard **enough** to break free. I **thought** the story was silly because knights usually ride horses, not swim! My sister just laughed at me.
